finding_or_change: Android now runs verified preparation behind a TV-local Cancel-first one-run consent bound to a deterministic manifest security-scope digest. Remote mutations only request consent, Stop revokes further work, install sessions explicitly require user action, Bootstrap export is idempotent, the strict flow does not edit Kodi settings, and progress cannot complete from a user assertion.
evidence: Consent is schema/app/security-scope/operation/generation bound and expires within 24 hours.
Same-version Bootstrap or install payload changes invalidate consent while telemetry-only changes do not.
Android 9 reads only Bootstrap applied_version; Android 10+ safely remains waiting where scoped storage prevents observation.
focused_validation: Eight consent, scope-digest, evidence-reader, and contract tests passed after the final digest tightening; Android diff check passed.
full_validation: Before the final digest-only tightening, the full Android JVM suite passed 22 tests and lintDebug passed; the final focused delta passed.
unresolved_risks: Device acceptance remains required for D-pad focus, installer denial/resume, Fire OS storage behavior, Stop timing, and visible confirmation sequencing.
Android 10+ cannot observe cross-app Kodi applied_version through this local path and intentionally remains waiting.
authority_or_approval_used: Android local source implementation and Gradle validation only; no device, deployment, release, publication, commit, or push.
recommended_next_action: Run the exact supported Fire OS and modern Android TV device matrix before packaging or release.
